No exact recursion/resource-exhaustion boundary equivalence claim: removing a final exact-scalar call can change a pathological stack threshold.

benchmark.ratio_definition: Median of nine paired candidate elapsed / restored literal-generator elapsed ratios; 200 conversions per measurement, alternating ordering; timeit disables cyclic GC during each timing. Below one is faster.
benchmark.conclusion: Synthetic scalar tuples improve, but actual golden contracts do not. No material actual-contract benefit justifies adding this conditional or any global-rebinding guards.
